subject.why: The bridge railing is clearly recognizable, packed with colourful heart padlocks and features the requested large golden heart padlock at the centre.

category.why: The low camera angle gives a heroic perspective over a clean strip of water at the bottom against a blue sky with soft cumulus clouds.

clean.why: No text, logos, UI, frames, or human characters are present.

framing.why: The bridge extends completely past the left and right canvas edges, leaving no side margins and cutting several padlocks in half.

colour.why: Vibrant, warm, and saturated palette with good contrast against the bright blue sky.

detail.why: The shapes are chunky and simplified with no noisy textures or micro-details.

style.why: The smooth, 3D-rendered volumes and soft satin sheen match the reference cards well.

fix: Scale down and frame the arched bridge railing so that its ends and all padlocks fit completely within the canvas with clear margins on both sides.
